put.description:
Need right update_object_item. When you place employee on empty place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' (previous place set as RESERVED) and 'seat' record. 
When you put the employee in the occupied place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' record about the removal of the previous 'employee from the place' / 'DS table' and 'moving' record to the current employee. 
When you removing employee from place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' record and 'moving_to_ds'/'moving_to_gt'/'reservation' for this place. 
If place switched to DS or reservation from empty status generates in HeartbeatsController 'moving_to_ds'/'moving_to_gt'/'reservation' for this place.

post.summary: Get Bookings. Supports remote-server pagination, sorting, filtering. Can return the result response also as .xls file(as_file=true).
post.description: No rights needed. Have different responses depending on parameters.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
- page - page in result table
- per_page - element per page in result table
- sorting have 2 properties: 
-- field - supports each column of bookings table and additional parameters
 ---  employee_label - sorting by surname and name
 --- object_item.buildings_name - sorting by buildings_name
 --- object_item.location_name - sorting by location_name
 --- place_path - sroting by object_items.name
 --- object_item.costcenter_num - sorting by object_items.costcenter_num
 --- status - sorting by bookings.book_from
 -- order have 2 values: ASC and DESC
- filters have 2 properties:
 -- field - supports all bookings columns and addtional:
 --- employee_label - filtering by surname and name
 --- object_item.buildings_name - filtering by buildings_name
 --- object_item.location_name - filtering by location_name
 --- place_path - filtering by object_items.name
 --- employee_id - filtering by employee_id
 --- floor_id - filtering by floor_id. If you want to get 'can_book' property in result response not only false, need to set 'floor_id' and 'place_id' in filters not empty and also not empty 'user_id'
 --- place_id - filtering by object_items.id. If you want to get 'can_book' property in result response not only false, need to set 'floor_id' and 'place_id' in filters not empty and also not empty 'user_id'
 --- archive_bookings - filter only archive bookings if have value 'true'
 --- current_booking - filter only current bookings if have value 'true'
 --- costcenter_selected - filtering by costcenter_num, format for value is '12345,54321,56789'
 --- buildings - filtering by buildings.id, format for value is '1,2,6,8,10'
 - as_file - if true return the same results like in 'bookings' in .xls format without 'can_book' and 'count'
 - user_id - using when you want to get can_book property not only false for concrete place, need to set 'floor_id' and 'place_id' in filters not empty and also user_id not empty
 - no_current_date - using for parking, when you need available object_items for today

post.description:
You might have set_booking_on_the_same_time need and/or book_for_others rights. 
If you set parameter employee and have both of this rights you can book for other people and for the same time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
- object_item - place that you want to book (status of this place must be SHARING). Actually, you must have only name parameter in object_item object.
- book_from and book_to must be like 'mm-dd-yyyy'.
- employee means for which colleague you want to book.
- switchState provide functionality of booking for people that aren't at our system, for example, for german colleagues in this case you need to set name and surname at employee field and this booking will be added to current logged in user that gets from token. By default set as true and means that employee in system.
 - comment - now it's technical field that using in case when you searching user in global search and you can see that it can have booking today.

559.description: Now happens when you try to book place for other employee without right book_for_others

put.description:
Need right update_heartbeat. When you place employee on empty place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' (previous place set as RESERVED) and 'seat' record. 
When you put the employee in the occupied place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' record about the removal of the previous 'employee from the place' / 'DS table' and 'moving' record to the current employee. 
When you removing employee from place generates in HeartbeatsController 'removing' record and 'moving_to_ds'/'moving_to_gt'/'reservation' for this place. 
If place switched to DS or reservation from empty status generates in HeartbeatsController 'moving_to_ds'/'moving_to_gt'/'reservation' for this place.
